title: Advanced
description: Configuration file, workarounds, privacy on public networks and diagnostics.

sections.title: Configuration file
sections.description: The shell's own settings file; Diagnostics below shows where the rest is saved.

sections.title: Workarounds
sections.description: Fixes for specific hardware or timing problems; leave them alone unless something misbehaves.

sections.title: Privacy on public networks
sections.description: Hide sensitive wallpapers and clipboard entries while you are on a public Wi-Fi.

sections.title: Hyprland notices
sections.description: Windows that Hyprland opens by itself; both are shown by default.

sections.title: Diagnostics
sections.description: Where each kind of setting is saved, whether it can be applied now, and Hyprland's own errors.

sections.title: Reset
sections.description: Return the shell to its default look and behavior.

entries.label: Location
entries.description: File that stores the shell settings.

entries.label: Open the file
entries.description: Open the configuration file in the default editor.

entries.label: Copy the path
entries.description: Copy the location of the configuration file.

entries.label: Startup wait for panels
entries.description: Extra wait before some panels read system state; raise it only if a panel shows empty or wrong data right after opening.

entries.label: Fix 1-pixel gap at the edge
entries.description: Extend the bar and screen corners one pixel past the edge to hide a gap on some screens.

entries.label: Browser identity for downloads
entries.description: Some sites block downloads without a browser-like identity; change it only if wallpapers or icons fail to load.

entries.label: Show tray item ids
entries.description: Add each tray icon's id to its tooltip, useful to hide or pin it.

entries.label: Hide sensitive wallpapers
entries.description: On a public Wi-Fi, a wallpaper whose path contains a keyword below is replaced by a plain color.
entries.help: The words are matched against the whole path, folders included.

entries.label: Hide sensitive clipboard entries
entries.description: On a public Wi-Fi, the launcher hides clipboard entries with links that contain a keyword below.

entries.label: Public Wi-Fi name words
entries.description: A Wi-Fi whose name contains one of these words counts as public, e.g. cafe, guest, eduroam.
entries.help: Both switches above need a match here before they hide anything.

entries.label: Sensitive file keywords
entries.description: A wallpaper whose file path contains one of these words counts as sensitive.

entries.label: Sensitive link keywords
entries.description: Clipboard entries with links containing these words are hidden.

entries.label: Hide the news after updating Hyprland
entries.description: Hyprland stops opening its what's-new window the first time it starts after an update.

entries.label: Hide Hyprland's donation request
entries.description: Hyprland stops showing the window that asks for a donation twice a year.

entries.label: Hyprland configuration errors
entries.description: Problems Hyprland found while loading its configuration, checked when this page opens.

entries.label: Where settings are saved
entries.description: Where each kind of setting is stored, and which parts can be changed right now.

entries.label: Reset every shell setting
entries.description: Back up the configuration file, then restore every shell setting shown in this app to its default.
entries.note: Hyprland, display, idle and default app settings are not changed.
